name: worktree-activity
description: Keep unfinished Git work attributable to its responsible Codex conversation until owner-verified completion or authorized cancellation.

interface.longDescription: Register unfinished assignments by native Codex conversation in existing authorized worktrees. Preserve ownership across interruptions, reconcile delegated results, and produce read-only recovery plans. Records never expire and never grant exclusive checkout access.
defaultPrompt: Register this development assignment in its existing worktree and preserve its ownership until verified completion.
Inspect these project roots and prepare a read-only recovery plan grouped by responsible conversation.

com.sealad886.marketplace.reason: Requires native Codex conversation identity and a user-facing coordinator.
